_meta.description: Education and professional experience timeline entries.

fields.experience: Array of internship, industry, or lab experience entries

education.title: Ph.D. in Theoretical and Applied Linguistics · Peking University
details: Advised by Prof. Qi Su at the Institute for Artificial Intelligence, with the PKU & ByteDance Digital Humanities Open Lab (PKUDH).

education.title: B.A. in English, Linguistics and Language Technologies · BUPT
details: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, School of Humanities; minor in Data Science and Big Data Technologies.
Started from the humanities, then learned mathematics, statistics, programming, and machine learning from scratch, moving into LLM research.

experience.title: Researcher · PKU & ByteDance Digital Humanities Open Lab (PKUDH)
details: Working on multi-modal intelligence for cultural heritage at the Institute for Artificial Intelligence, Peking University.
Research spanning computational Chinese paleography and stylistic evaluation of LLM outputs (CLASE).

experience.title: Visiting Algorithm Engineer · Qwen Team, Alibaba Group
details: Worked on foundation models for heritage science, in collaboration with PKUDH.

experience.title: Research Intern · TsinghuaNLP
details: AI for humanities & social science, with Prof. Zhiyuan Liu.
Built multi-agent court scenario simulation and evaluated LLMs' proficiency on legalese in the Legal AI subdivision.

education.title: 北京大学 · 理论语言学与应用语言学博士
details: 于北京大学人工智能学院师从苏祺教授（Qi Su），在北京大学·字节跳动数字人文开放实验室（PKUDH）开展研究。
研究方向为基础语言模型（foundation language models）。

education.title: 北京邮电大学 · 英语、语言学与语言技术专业文学学士
details: 人文学院英语、语言学与语言技术专业，辅修数据科学与大数据技术。
从人文出发，自学数学、统计、编程与机器学习，逐步走向大语言模型研究。

experience.title: 北京大学·字节跳动数字人文开放实验室（PKUDH）· 研究人员
details: 在北京大学人工智能学院从事文化遗产多模态智能研究。
研究涵盖计算古文字学与大模型输出的中文风格评测（CLASE）。

experience.title: 阿里巴巴通义千问团队（Qwen Team）· 访问算法工程师
details: 从事面向文化遗产科学的基础模型研究，与 PKUDH 合作。

experience.title: 清华大学自然语言处理实验室（TsinghuaNLP）· 研究实习
details: 与刘知远教授（Zhiyuan Liu）从事面向人文与社会科学的 AI 研究。
在法律 AI 方向构建多智能体法庭场景模拟，并评估大模型的法律语言能力。
